recommendation: Keep the source fix. No further core change is needed for FHIR-36213 unless the work group separately decides to retire or repurpose the now-unbound Device operation status-reason terminology after later Device modeling changes.
issue_request: FHIR-36213 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested an example value set for Device.operation.statusReason, replacing Device.operationalStatus.reason, using the approved nine-code MDC-derived example list.
initial_application: Commit 50f4a45ebb2bb55a1ebcdc1a491aebc2b0c1f8b1 added the device-operation-status-reason CodeSystem and ValueSet and bound Device.operation.statusReason to the new ValueSet. The approved codes survived in current source, but the standalone CodeSystem and ValueSet descriptions still said 'availability status reason', which was stale for an operation/operational status reason artifact.
additional_context: FHIR-32409 was the earlier Device binding issue behind this terminology family, FHIR-36208 created the companion Device.operation.status value set, FHIR-37545 later renamed operationalState/operationalStatus concepts to operation-specific terminology names, and FHIR-38904 later removed the active Device.operation status/statusReason/operator backbone. Current Device is active in source/fhir.ini, but XML parsing finds no active Device.operation paths; the operation-status-reason terminology remains in source with the approved FHIR-36213 codes. OO Confluence minutes reference FHIR-36213 and the Jira vote, and targeted Zulip searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Updated source/device/codesystem-device-operation-status-reason.xml and source/device/valueset-device-operation-status-reason.xml descriptions from availability status reason to current operational status reason. No element or code-list changes were made because later final Device modeling decisions removed Device.operation from the active current StructureDefinition and the approved code list was already present.
